I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is **#8841**.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted it in #central-random on 13 Oct at 09:27. He wrote that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it for support on #8841.
- **One gap:** Tobias said "dealer account" and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. The Jan 2026 Central handoff digest (a public file) is what links Marrow Fieldworks to "the dealer account." So it's very likely the same account, but I said so in the reply and pointed her to Tobias if she needs to be sure.
- **What I read:** only places Pree can see herself: channels she belongs to and public files. I didn't use message search. A ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
